ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation Obfuscated IEX Invocation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects all variations of obfuscated powershell IEX invocation code generated by Invoke-Obfuscation framework from the following code block

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX("$PSHome[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$PSHome[") OR process_command_line = RGX("$ShellId[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$ShellId[") OR process_command_line = RGX("$env:Public[\s*\d{1,3}\s*]\s*+\s*$env:Public[") OR process_command_line = RGX("$env:ComSpec[(\s*\d{1,3}\s*,){2}") OR process_command_line = RGX("*mdr*W\s*).Name") OR process_command_line = RGX("$VerbosePreference.ToString(") OR process_command_line = RGX("[String]\s*$VerbosePreference"))
